Description: Map ALL personal data: what you collect, where it's stored, how it flows, who accesses it. First step before any compliance work.
Implementation: Create data flow diagram|List all data sources (forms+analytics+payments+support)|Classify as PII vs non-PII|Identify third-party data sharing
DIY_Tool: Google Sheets template or OneTrust free
Verification: Review quarterly|Update when adding new tools or integrations
Risk_If_Ignored: Cannot comply with GDPR/CCPA if you don't know what data you have

Description: Every piece of personal data needs a documented lawful basis: consent, contractual necessity, legitimate interest, or legal obligation.
Implementation: Map each data collection point to a lawful basis|Document reasoning|Consent must be freely given, specific, informed, unambiguous
DIY_Tool: Privacy policy generator + consent management tool
Verification: Audit: can you justify every data field you collect?
Risk_If_Ignored: Processing without lawful basis = GDPR violation. Fines up to €20M or 4% global turnover

Description: Obtain clear active consent before collecting non-essential data. No pre-checked boxes. Users must be able to withdraw consent as easily as they gave it.
Implementation: Use Cookiebot or OneTrust for cookie consent|Separate consent per purpose|Record when/how consent given|Provide 1-click withdrawal
Verification: Test: can users withdraw consent in 1 click?|Are pre-checked boxes removed?
Risk_If_Ignored: Invalid consent = all data processing based on it is unlawful

Description: Clear human-readable privacy policy: what data collected, why, how long kept, who it's shared with, user rights. No legal jargon.
Implementation: Use Termly or Iubenda to generate|Customize for your actual practices|Include: data collected, purpose, retention, third parties, user rights, contact
Verification: Annual review|Update when practices change|Test: can a non-lawyer understand it?
Risk_If_Ignored: GDPR fines + CCPA fines $7500/violation + user trust destroyed

Description: Handle user requests to: access their data, correct it, delete it, export it, restrict processing. Respond within 30 days (GDPR) or 45 days (CCPA).
Implementation: Build admin panel for data export/deletion|Automate where possible|Train support team on DSAR handling|Log all requests and responses
Verification: Test: submit a DSAR to yourself. Can you respond in 30 days?|Is data export machine-readable?
Risk_If_Ignored: Failure to respond = violation. Repeated failures = enforcement action

Description: Build privacy into product architecture from the start. Collect minimum data needed. Default to most privacy-friendly settings.
Implementation: Collect only data you actually use|Default privacy settings to most restrictive|Anonymize or pseudonymize where possible|Delete data when purpose fulfilled
Verification: Review: for each data field, ask 'do we actually need this?'|Can you delete user data completely?
Risk_If_Ignored: Retrofitting privacy is 10x harder and more expensive than building it in

Description: Collect ONLY data absolutely necessary for the stated purpose. If you don't need birthdate, don't collect it.
Implementation: Audit every form field: is it necessary?|Remove optional fields that don't serve a purpose|Don't collect 'nice to have' data
Verification: Count form fields|For each: can you justify why you need it?
Risk_If_Ignored: Over-collection increases breach impact and regulatory risk

Description: Categorize cookies: strictly necessary (no consent needed), analytics, marketing, functional. Get consent before setting non-essential cookies.
Implementation: Implement cookie consent banner|Block non-essential cookies until consent|Categorize all cookies|Allow granular opt-out|Record consent
Verification: Scan site with Cookiebot scanner|Verify no cookies fire before consent given
Risk_If_Ignored: €10M+ fines for cookie violations in EU. Active enforcement in France/Germany

Description: Detect + notify within 72 hours (GDPR). Plan: 1) Detect 2) Contain 3) Assess scope 4) Notify authority 5) Notify affected users 6) Post-mortem.
Implementation: Write incident response plan|Assign breach response roles|Set up monitoring/alerting|Template notification letters ready|Practice with tabletop exercise
Verification: Tabletop exercise annually|Review plan quarterly|Update contact info
Risk_If_Ignored: Missing 72-hour GDPR deadline = separate violation. Panic response without plan = worse outcome

Description: Vet ALL third-party services that handle personal data. Ensure they're compliant. Sign Data Processing Agreements (DPAs).
Implementation: List all vendors that receive user data|Check each vendor's GDPR compliance|Sign DPA with each|Monitor vendor compliance annually|Have contingency if vendor fails
Verification: Annual vendor review|Check: do all data-processing vendors have signed DPAs?
Risk_If_Ignored: You're responsible for your vendors' data handling. Their breach = your problem

Description: California users have right to: know what data collected, delete data, opt-out of sale, non-discrimination. Required if >$25M revenue or >50K consumers.
Implementation: Add 'Do Not Sell My Personal Information' link|Honor opt-out requests within 15 days|Provide data deletion mechanism|Update privacy policy with CCPA disclosures
Verification: Test: is 'Do Not Sell' link visible?|Can users delete data?|Response within 45 days?
Risk_If_Ignored: $7,500 per intentional violation. Class action risk. AG enforcement increasing

Description: If product could attract users under 13: verifiable parental consent required before collecting any data. Or: age-gate and block under-13 access.
Implementation: Add age verification|If under 13 detected: block or get parental consent|Never target ads to children|Review data practices for child safety
Verification: Test: can a minor sign up without parental consent?
Risk_If_Ignored: $50,000+ per violation. FTC actively enforcing. Massive PR risk

Description: Transferring EU data outside EU requires: adequacy decision (US-EU Privacy Framework), Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), or Binding Corporate Rules.
Implementation: Check if data leaves EU|Implement Standard Contractual Clauses with non-EU vendors|Use EU-hosted infrastructure when possible|Document transfer impact assessment
Verification: Map data flows: does any data leave the EU?|Are SCCs in place?
Risk_If_Ignored: Illegal data transfer = processing without legal basis = full GDPR penalty

Description: Define how long you keep each type of data. Delete when purpose fulfilled. Don't keep data 'just in case'.
Implementation: Create retention schedule per data type|Automate deletion for expired data|Document retention periods in privacy policy|Exception process for legal holds
Verification: Quarterly: check if any data exceeds retention period|Test automated deletion
Risk_If_Ignored: Over-retention increases breach impact and violates storage limitation principle

Description: Document technical and organizational security measures: encryption, access controls, backup, employee training. Required for GDPR audits.
Implementation: Document: encryption (at rest + transit), access control policy, backup procedures, employee training records, incident response plan
Verification: Annual review|Update when security measures change|Available for audit
Risk_If_Ignored: Cannot demonstrate compliance = assumed non-compliant. Harder to defend in case of breach
